conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Kavya Sharma. Mera debit card ka contactless feature kaise activate karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Kavya ji, main aapko guide karta hoon. Kya aap apna card number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine check kiya, aapka card contactless feature support karta hai. Aap mobile app ya ATM se ise activate kar sakti hain. Main steps SMS karta hoon.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, SMS bhej do. Kitna time lagega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Turant activate ho jayega jaise hi aap steps follow karengi. Koi aur madad?
